product.name: IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card

benefits.name: Anniversary Free Night Award
benefits.estimate_basis: Award valid at properties costing up to 40,000 IHG One Rewards points, valued at 0.5 cents per point per The Points Guy July 2026 valuations. Points from your own balance can top up a pricier property, so the ceiling is a floor on real value.
benefits.merchant_scope: One night at a property costing up to 40,000 points
benefits.notes: Issued on the account anniversary each year.

benefits.name: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status
benefits.notes: Complimentary elite status while the card is open. No dollar value is tracked.
